name: Sakura Chroma
avoid_for: Decks that need restrained, corporate, or quiet typography — the bold condensed lockups, ribbon stripes, and primary-colour palette are intentionally loud and product-page-y
weak_cases: Seals can imply authority; equalizer segment counts must encode real values rather than ornament.
visual_signature: Warm cream and brown ink, petal clusters, diagonal ribbons and mono spec rows.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Japanese accents require meaningful approved text; named Noto Sans JP does not establish whole-deck language support.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
